title: [Web] Pricing settings: "Save Changes" stays disabled when a quote only has a Minimum or Mobilization override
body:
*Video (steps on screen):* [^QA-13Nov-BUG-pricing-settings-save-disabled-video-steps.mp4]



h3. Simple explanation
* On a Plans v2 quote, open the gear "Pricing settings" and turn on only *Minimum* (or only *Mobilization*), then save. That works.
* Open Pricing settings again. *Save Changes is greyed out before you touch anything*, and it stays greyed out whatever you change.
* The only way to save is to switch *Round up* on and off again. That saves {{labor_round_hours = 0}} on the quote, so the quote silently stops following the company's round-up default.
* Cause: when the quote has another override but no round-up value, the Round up field starts with the text {{"undefined"}}, which fails validation and disables Save.

h3. Links (QA)
* Quote used: [https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/plans/d20d398a-26de-424c-b672-b34e92d1a9df] (QA-DEMO ZP-5242 13 Nov mobilization units)
* Any v2 quote with labor shows it. Another example: [https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/plans/65ccf113-2d50-4b51-bda6-9139df8ea9a0]

h3. Actual vs Expected
* *Actual:* after saving a Minimum-only (or Mobilization-only) override, reopening Pricing settings shows Save Changes disabled. It stays disabled after changing Mobilization, Minimum or the inflation rate. The Round up row shows "Off".
* *Expected:* Save Changes is enabled once something changes. Round up shows the company default (or Off) and is not sent unless the user changes it.

h3. Test data
* Environment: QA, [https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai], build {{index-C6DvLko9.js}}, 13 Nov 2026.
* Seat: Super Admin (QA staff seat). Project Manager and Account Manager seats have the same gear and dialog (reproduced only with Super Admin).
* Quote id {{d20d398a-26de-424c-b672-b34e92d1a9df}}: Plans v2, service Arc Flash Data Collection (rate-priced), 4 assets, company pricing defaults all Off.
* Re-proven 3 times: ~13:38 IST (Mobilization-only), ~13:46 IST (Minimum-only), 14:12 IST (Minimum-only, this video).

h3. Steps to reproduce (clean start)
# Sign in → Sales → Quotes → open a v2 quote that has labor lines and no pricing overrides.
# On the Pricing tab click the gear *Pricing settings*. Round up and Minimum are Off; Save Changes is enabled. *(screenshot 1)*
# Turn on *Minimum* and type *8* (leave Round up alone) → *Save Changes*. The labor rows now say "topped up to the 8h minimum". *(screenshot 2)*
# Click the gear *Pricing settings* again. *Save Changes is already disabled.* *(screenshot 3)*
# Turn on *Mobilization → Per move = 30*. *Save Changes stays disabled.* *(screenshot 4)*
# (Workaround) Turn *Round up* on and off again. Save Changes becomes enabled → Save. The quote is saved, but with an explicit {{labor_round_hours: 0}}. *(screenshot 5, end of video)*

The same happens if step 3 sets only Mobilization instead of Minimum.

h3. Notes for the developer
* API evidence ({{GET /api/plans/\{id\}}} → {{instructions.pricing}}):
** after step 3: {{\{labor_min_hours: 8\}}} (no {{labor_round_hours}});
** after the step 6 workaround: {{\{labor_round_hours: 0, labor_min_hours: 8, mobilization_minutes: 30\}}}.
* Workaround side effect: {{labor_round_hours: 0}} is an explicit per-quote override. If the company later turns on a round-up default, this quote keeps ignoring it.
* Code (PlanDetail chunk, {{jt()}} that opens the dialog): the Round up value is initialised with `{{ }}$\{hasAnyOverride ? instructions.pricing.labor_round_hours : company\}{{ }}`. When the quote has a Minimum or Mobilization override but no round-up key, this becomes the string {{"undefined"}}. The Save button is disabled by {{!Be}}, where {{Be = m !== "" && isFinite(Number(m)) && …}}, and {{Number("undefined")}} is NaN.
* Minimum and Mobilization already use a null-safe fallback ({{x != null && x !== "" ? x : company}}). Using the same for Round up should fix it.
* Not affected: a quote with no overrides, or one that already has a Round up override.
